item.title: Pakistan’s Parliament passes law establishing commission to focus on minority rights
item.description: Pakistan’s parliament has approved long-delayed legislation to establish a National Commission for Minorities Rights. #Pakistan #minorietyrights #religiousfreedom #persecution

item.title: Ultra-processed foods fueling chronic diseases, mental illnesses globally: study
item.description: A growing consumption of ultra-processed foods such as breakfast cereals, yogurts, soda, cookies and even infant formula is fueling an increase in chronic diseases, including mental illnesses around the world, according to a global team of public health experts.. #Ultraprocessedfood #Chronicdisease #Cancer

item.title: Church-state watchdog group leader appointed to US Commission on International Religious Freedom
item.description: The leader of a progressive church-state watchdog group has been appointed to the United States Commission on International Religious Freedom. #RachelLaser #USCIRF #religiousfreedom #Jewish #Schumer #churchandstate #secularism

item.title: Over 1,000 American pastors vow to stand with Israel after visiting Oct. 7 massacre sites, survivors
item.description: Over 1,000 American pastors and Christian influencers pledged to support the Jewish people during a recent tour in Israel, where the delegation laid flowers on the graves of soldiers who died during the Israel-Hamas war and witnessed the impact of the terror group’s Oct. 7 massacre. #ChristianZionist #FriendsofZion #Zionism #Israel #Hamas #antisemitism

item.title: Elon Musk blasts Gavin Newsom for taunting him over trans son: 'Evil woke mind virus'
item.description: SpaceX CEO Elon Musk hit back at Democratic California Gov. Gavin Newsom on Friday after the X account of Newsom's press office taunted him over his transgender-identifying son. #ElonMusk #GavinNewsom #transgender #California

item.title: Texas AG, securities board offer conflicting takes on latest lawsuit against proposed Muslim-focused community
item.description: Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton has filed a lawsuit targeting a proposed Muslim-focused residential community in North Texas, accusing developers of an "illegal development scheme" that violated state securities laws. #AGKenPaxton #Texas #EPICCity

item.title: Fla. sues WPATH, other groups for pushing body mutilating trans surgeries for kids
item.description: Florida Attorney General James Uthmeier has filed a complaint against three professional groups, alleging they mislead the public regarding transgender procedures for minors. #Florida #transgender #RICO #attorneygeneral #LGBT #lawsuit #fraud

item.title: MyPillow CEO Mike Lindell announces run for Minnesota governor: 'I'm still standing'
item.description: Mike Lindell announced his candidacy for the Minnesota gubernatorial race Thursday, throwing his hat into the race against former Democratic vice presidential candidate, Gov. Tim Walz, who is running for his third consecutive four-year term. #MikeLindell #Minnesota #MyPillow #TimWalz

item.title: UMC pushes back on reported plan to 'geotarget' Texas churchgoers with pro-Israel messaging
item.description: A United Methodist Church official is pushing back against a controversial “geofencing” plan to target churchgoers in Texas and other states with messaging from an organization acting as an agent of the state of Israel. #UMC #Texas #Israel #unitedmethodistchurch #churches #ShowFaithbyWorks

item.title: ACNA inquiry board finds Archbishop Steve Wood should be put on trial for allegedly violating vows, sexual immorality
item.description: The head of the Anglican Church in North America should be put on trial for allegedly violating ordination vows and for sexual immorality, a denominational investigative body has concluded. #AnglicanChurchinNorthAmerica #boardofinquiry #sexualimmorality #court #ACNA #SteveWood
